correctness.rationale: Re-audited repairs/2/RESULT.md, which retains the mathematically valid nonlinear theorem and makes prior linear coverage explicit. The printed system uses total food U+C, so its sum is conserved and the positive-mass disease-free point is on a different leaf from the printed zero-food point. For B>0 the food quadratic has exactly one positive root in (0,F), with positive derivative in C at the root and hence C'(B)>0. Independently, the food balance gives C/B=(F−C)/(Δ+a4 C) with positive denominator; its derivative in C is −p/(Δ+a4 C)^2, so C/B strictly decreases with B. The human balances reduce all strictly positive equilibria to an intersection of a strictly decreasing continuous function and a strictly increasing continuous function on (0,Λ/(μ+δ)). At the upper endpoint only the latter diverges. At the lower endpoint the food ratio tends to F/Δ when Δ>0 and diverges for Δ≤0: the continuous limiting positive branch is max(0,−Δ/a4), leaving a positive numerator in either nonpositive-Δ case. Thus there is one crossing iff the stated strict threshold is satisfied when Δ>0, none at equality, and one crossing for every positive β otherwise. Every crossing reconstructs strictly positive S,I,B,U,C. The rational witness checks all five right-hand sides directly and lies at positive food mass with printed index 2/3. In the background linear comparison, the Metzler block is irreducible, so pairing the test-vector identity with its positive left Perron vector gives the sign for Δ>0. For Δ≤0, the monic characteristic polynomial at z=−Δ is strictly negative, giving a positive root. No nonlinear stability is inferred from a zero eigenvalue.
residual_risks: The exact result applies only to strictly positive rates and the standalone printed equations on a fixed positive leaf. It does not establish stability of the positive equilibrium, global dynamics, or behavior in the larger co-infection model.

originality.rationale: Pass for the narrowed nonlinear claim only. The original presentation of a new disease-free index and local threshold does not pass: Resultary c83367963703 already gives that same index and linear classification for Δ>0, including a zero eigenvalue at equality. The earlier record also notes instability for Δ<0, and its characteristic polynomial gives instability at Δ=0 by sign. The replacement title, finding and proof instead identify and prove the exact nonlinear count on all positive-mass leaves, credit the earlier threshold, and place the linear conclusions in background. Neither the prior local calculation nor the inspected broader epidemic models supply that global-in-parameters equilibrium count.
residual_risks: The full 2020 Chukwu–Nyabadza text could not be inspected. A closer theorem for the same equations or one implying the exact fixed-leaf count could remain unindexed or inaccessible.
No priority claim is made for the local disease-free threshold or known food-feedback mechanisms.

value.rationale: The repaired result corrects an explicit published if-and-only-if equilibrium statement. It predicts the exact number of positive equilibria, not just whether the disease-free state is unstable; it certifies absence at equality when the index is finite and settles both cases where that index is not applicable. The explicit equilibrium witness makes the distinction from the known linear correction checkable. This is a complete mathematical result on the printed conservation leaves, not an empirical disease prediction.
residual_risks: The significance is in the exact printed-model analysis; application to real contamination or public-health policy would require independent empirical evidence.
